# One Coat Technologies

> > Michigan-based protective coating manufacturer specializing in floor epoxy, polyurethane, and custom-formulated specialty coatings for industrial, marine, and commercial applications.

One Coat Technologies, headquartered in Jenison, Michigan, manufactures waterborne and solventborne coating systems including the OneThane 2KU product line. The company serves the Detroit metro area and beyond with custom formulations for flooring, waterproofing, countertops, and marine applications.

## Key Topics

- Epoxy flooring systems
- Polyurethane coatings
- OneThane 2KU product line
- Solventborne technologies
- Water-based coatings
- Custom formulated coatings
- Industrial protective coatings
- Resinous flooring
- Marine coatings
- Waterproofing solutions
- Specialty coatings
- Michigan manufacturing
- Countertop coatings
- Detroit area services
